title: Analogue-gravity horizons as exact $q$-deformed substrate constraints
html:
Remark. Analogue-gravity horizons as exact q-deformed substrate constraints

Mathematical novelty. Analogue gravity routinely constructs acoustic metrics and Hawking temperatures; the novelty is instantiating this framework on the q-deformed categorical substrate. The acoustic horizon conditions are not physical analogies but exact geometric constraints on the q-Navier-Stokes fluid. The cyclotomic factor \hbar_q = (q-1)/q suppresses the resulting Hawking temperature.
